alexcrichton opened PR #14550 from alexcrichton:real-join-handle to bytecodealliance:main:

Internally this type used a TryMutex with explicit panic-on-contention since it was originally internal to the runtime, but since then it's become an external API of the runtime meaning it's possible to use this in cross-thread situations where panicking-on-contention is not suitable. Rig up some thin Mutex<T> wrappers to use with our sync-style abstractions and use that instead.
